newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 3,481 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 3,481 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totalled 3,481 contracts compared with 2,120 overnight Tuesday, according to the CBOT.
There were 79 wheat, 1,776 corn, 1,412 soybean, 61 soymeal, 17 soyoil, three oat, 91 corn calls, nine corn puts and 33 soybean calls traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was steady to 3/4 cent higher, corn was three to five cents higher and soybeans were two to five cents higher.
